## Problem

What is wrong or missing, and who it affects. Link the issue or discussion where a maintainer approved it, unless
this is a small, obvious bug fix ([CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/quokka-bot/quokkabot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#problem-first)).

## Change

What this PR does about it.

## Verification

How you found the problem, what you ran to check the fix and what it showed, and what you could not check. UI
changes need before and after screenshots.

If an AI agent wrote this PR, name the model and the tool you ran it in.
